bio.en: Overall Operations Director and Shareholder of the company with 25+ years of experience in construction management, leading strategic vision and growth.
bio.am: የኩባንያው አጠቃላይ የኦፕሬሽን ዳይሬክተር እና ባለአክሲዮን ከ25+ ዓመታት በላይ ልምድ ያለው፣ ስትራቴጂያዊ ራዕይ እና እድገትን ይመራል።
bio.om: Keenya Hojii fi Qondaala Idilaa qabduu fi qondaala qabduu kan waggaa 25+ muuxannoo bulchiinsa ijaarsaa qabu, mul'ata fi guddina qajeelcha.

bio.en: Shareholder and Chief Technical Officer, expert in structural design with 20 years of innovative engineering solutions.
bio.am: ባለአክሲዮን እና ዋና ቴክኒካል ኦፊሰር፣ በመዋቅራዊ ዲዛይን ላይ ባለሙያ ከ20 ዓመታት የፈጠራ ምህንድስና መፍትሄዎች ጋር።
bio.om: Qondaala fi Keessaa Teekniikaa, ogummaa ijaarsa caasaa waggaa 20 furmaata injineerii uumamaa qabu.

bio.en: Senior Manager at the company, overseeing multi-million dollar projects with precision and efficiency.
bio.am: በኩባንያው ከፍተኛ አስተዳዳሪ፣ በትክክለኛነት እና በብቃት ብዙ ሚሊዮን ዶላር ፕሮጀክቶችን ይቆጣጠራል።
bio.om: Bulchii Ol'aanaa kan kampaanichaa, porjeektota dollarii miliyoona hedduu sirnaan fi qajeelchaniin bulchiisa.

bio.en: Junior Marketing Manager assisting with campaign coordination, social media presence, and market research.
bio.am: የዘመቻ አስተባባሪነትን፣ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መገኘትን እና የገበያ ጥናትን የሚረዳ ጁኒየር የግብይት ማናጀር።
bio.om: Hoogganaa Gabaa Xiqqaa qindaa'ina kampeenii, argama miidiyaa hawaasaa, fi qorannoo gabaa gargaaru.
